initial_external_facts: Bound host and admitted catalog snapshot
Pin storage snapshot or explicit unavailability
entry_intent: OpenApplications with a current view stamp
supported_actions: Pin the first matching unpinned entry
Unpin or move a pinned entry when enabled
Open actions for the first result
Acknowledge an unknown launch after checking windows
expected_observations: Search only filters and orders results
Pending and Unknown disable launch choices
Submitted is a submission receipt and closes Applications
Refused and Unknown use source status wording
A new observed application window alone admits a portal
Refresh reads facts and does not replay a mutation
